question: Sonal Mansingh got the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for which form of dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sonal Mansingh** was awarded the **Sangeet Natak Akademi** Award in **1987**. She is a trained **Odissi dancer**.
 
• Sonal Mansingh** is a prominent Indian dancer, teacher, researcher, choreographer, and social activist.**
 
• She i**s known for her work in both Odissi and Bharatanatyam, a **South Indian dance form that originated in Tamil Nadu
 
• She has won many awards including the **Padma Bhushan** and the **Sangeet Natak academy award**, one of the highest **honour** awards of** India**.
 
• Sonal Mansingh has **also written books, including Classical Dances, Draupadi, Devpriya, and The Penguin Book of Indian Dance. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi recognizes eight classical dance in India.
